_comment: Authoring contract handed to every Phase B (per-RGD authoring) subagent. Static JSON so N concurrent authors converge on the same conventions. Update in ONE place; never fork per subagent.

labels._purpose: Selection-friendly, regex-constrained ([A-Za-z0-9._-]). Applied on RGD and on every rendered CR under resources/.

required.rekoncile.io/rgd: RGD name owning this resource, e.g. rekoncile-demo-app-stack-adopt

on_rgd_only.rekoncile.io/tf-module: TF module the RGD represents, e.g. vpc, eks, root

annotations._purpose: Free-form, no regex constraints. Carry exact TF traceability info that would fail label validation.

required_on_rendered_cr.rekoncile.io/from-tf-address: Exact TF address including brackets, e.g. module.vpc.aws_subnet.public[0]
required_on_rendered_cr.rekoncile.io/tf-attributes: JSON map {ackField: 'tf.attribute.source or explanation'} for every populated field

services.k8s.aws/adoption-policy.when_to_use_adopt: Strict import — ACK reads spec from live state. Ideal spec: {}.
services.k8s.aws/adoption-policy.when_to_use_adopt_or_create: You want the CR to double as create-if-missing. Fully populated spec required.

adoption_annotations.services.k8s.aws/adoption-fields: Lookup JSON per resource type. Keys per adoption_fields_by_kind below.

services.k8s.aws/deletion-policy.rationale: Prevents accidental deletion of live AWS resource if CR is removed.

spec_shape.reality: Most ACK v1.x CRDs enforce OpenAPI required-field validation even on adopt. Populate ONLY the required subset with live values. Add comment '# CRD-required minimum on adopt; ACK re-reads on adopt.'

create_mode_rules.spec_shape: Fully populated. Cross-refs inside an RGD use KRO refs (roleRef.from.name / vpcRef.from.name / targetKeyRef.from.name) not string interpolation, unless referring to status.ackResourceMetadata.arn.
create_mode_rules.parameterization: Every value that comes from a Terraform variable becomes a schema.spec field with the TF default preserved.

consolidation_rules._purpose: TF resources that ACK folds into a parent CR. Do NOT emit as separate CRs.
consolidation_rules.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment: Merged into iam/Role.spec.policies as ARN list. On adopt, ACK observes the attachment from AWS.
consolidation_rules.aws_route_table_association: Merged into ec2/RouteTable.spec.associations (or reference the RouteTable from Subnet, controller-dependent).
consolidation_rules.aws_security_group_rule: Merged into ec2/SecurityGroup.spec.{ingressRules,egressRules}. Standalone Rule CRDs (ec2/SecurityGroupRule) exist too — verify per-controller.
consolidation_rules.aws_ec2_tag: Merged into target resource's spec.tags list.
consolidation_rules.aws_route: Merged into ec2/RouteTable.spec.routes[]. Note: apigatewayv2/Route is unrelated to VPC routes.

grounding_loop._purpose: Every Phase B subagent runs this loop before returning success.
steps: 4. If any severity=error: re-author the offending resource, go to step 2.
5. Return success only after both validators return 0 errors OR 3 attempts have been made.
grounding_loop.escalation: If attempts_needed >= 3 with unresolved errors, main skill surfaces to operator at Phase 4 checkpoint.

capability_role_trust_policy.note: EKS capability roles use a DIFFERENT trust relationship from cluster (eks.amazonaws.com) and node (ec2.amazonaws.com) roles. Every dedicated capability role must use this trust policy.
